parts.name: Steel camshaft with four eccentric demonstration lobes

production.finish: Turn journals and eccentric circular lobes with offset fixtures. Deburr and finish bearing surfaces.

parts.source: Owner requests a steel camshaft. Four eccentric circular lobes at the cylinder stations are a design choice. The rejected candidate used 2 mm eccentricity with internally tangent lobe and journal surfaces. This repair uses 1.5 mm eccentricity and derives lobe radius from the unchanged 8 mm swept radius, giving a nominal 1 mm shaft-containment margin. This arithmetic is not measured topology evidence. Lobes retain quarter-turn phase increments. No valve timing, follower motion or synchronized drive is established. Shaft retention and service-cover support remain to be constructed.

Integral tongues enter the existing side-open bearing slots. Two drilled oil feeds share the existing cam-bushing stations and cross-hole axes. Four clearance holes match the block fastening pattern.
